scope: Proposition 6.1 (Cancellation for an ordered pair) of the manuscript “A Power Saving for Polynomial Differences at Prime Arguments” (preprints/A-Power-Saving-for-Polynomial-Differences-at-Prime-Arguments-October-5-2026/prime-argument-polynomial-differences.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 182 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b42ac864305ade86), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 29-30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose N is sufficiently large, l ≤ Nζ, and D = M0 Q p∈B p ≤ Nβ, where B is a finite set of primes at least P. Let J1, J2 : [N] → C have 29 modulus at most one and be supported on residue classes a′ 1, a′ 2 (mod D). Assume that r = a′ 2 − a′ 1 (mod D) is admissible at l and that J1(x)J2(y) ̸= 0 =⇒ x < y and y − x / ∈ Dl. Set Ξ = {ξ ∈ Q/Z : q(ξ) ≤ H, q(ξ) squarefree, (q(ξ), D) = 1}. Then, for the multiplier of any directed cycle edge, D X ξ∈Ξ Γ(ξ)c J1[N](−ξ)c J2[N](ξ) ≪ H−γ/2 . (6.4)
